name: House Steward
original_name: 家令《ハウス・スチュワード》
source:
One of the pursuers from C.R.O.W.N., a secret society that’s chasing after the main characters.

He also serves the Chancellor as his butler. 

An elderly gentleman who takes politeness very seriously, but he's a professional assassin who eliminates his targets with respect.

Hometown: England
